title: Developer changelog entry frontmatter
description: One file per change in packages/docs/changelog/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.md. The body is the note, at most 150 words. scripts/gen-reference.mjs validates every entry against this file and writes reference/changelog and the upgrade tables.

version.description: The release that ships it: 0.9.18, or 0.9.x when no patch is named.

services.description: Service slugs from tools/services.json; empty when the change is not a service's.

sdks.description: SDK ids from src/lib/docs.ts SDK_IDS; empty when no SDK is touched.

replaces.description: Rows of the upgrade page's Removed and Use instead tables, one table per surface. Markdown, code spans included.
